description: tangent-hole's hole, touching the plate's side face from inside, moved across the contact by a quarter of a tolerance (1e-7), out through the face (d > 0) and in off it (d < 0): within the tolerance the pose is the contact's, and Arris refuses it as tangent-hole does, OpError::Degenerate with Reason::TangentContact naming the pair. Open CASCADE builds a shape of odd Euler characteristic either way, as at the contact (plans/c3-tolerance-apart step 9, the band's ends).
